theme_and_concept.vibe: Premium, craftsman-like, reliable, clean, modern, quality. Awwwards-level execution for a tradesman company.
theme_and_concept.concept: The Anti-AI Tradesman. Forget cheap blue and white contractor templates. We use deep anthracite, gold accents, and high-end editorial typography to frame MAFER as a premium service. The site should feel like an elite architecture studio rather than a standard cleaning/painting service.

rules: Use layer elevation instead of shadows. Each surface should be slightly lighter than the layer below it.

CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background is banned. Use solid surface colors or heavy backdrop blur (e.g., bg-[#121316]/90 backdrop-blur-xl).
Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for normal text and 3:1 for large text.
Buttons MUST have clear hover states that increase lightness.

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, or Clash Display
rules: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Use fluid scaling for heroes. Max heading size text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl. DO NOT exceed this.
Tight letter spacing on headings (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Add overlines/labels that are Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tighter text-white
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#D97706]

layouts_and_grids.spacing_system: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8). Use py-24 or py-32 for section spacing.
layouts_and_grids.services_grid: Use a Bento Grid approach. Asymmetrical. col-span-full md:col-span-8 for the main service, col-span-4 for the others.
layouts_and_grids.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align text for better readability, never center everything blindly.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: MUST use 'lenis' for smooth scrolling to give the site premium momentum.
motion_and_interactions.hero: Kinetic hero with masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: One slow editorial marquee for the 'Další řemeslné práce' or 'Reviews'. Use 'react-fast-marquee'.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Hover states on all cards to subtly lift (-translate-y-1) and reveal a 1px border of the accent color.
motion_and_interactions.slider: Draggable Before/After comparison slider (custom built with Framer Motion or a dedicated library).

component_instructions.navigation: Sticky header (z-50). Must have a solid or heavy blur background (bg-[#0A0A0C]/80 backdrop-blur-md). Includes Logo, links, and ZAVOLAT (Call) CTA.
component_instructions.hero_section: Dual CTA (Nezávazně poptat, Zavolat), big background photo of craftsman with overlay (bg-black/40 or gradient), Trust Badge (e.g., '10+ Years Experience').
component_instructions.services_section: 3 Main Cards (Malířské práce, Úklidové služby, Vyklízecí práce). Use dark UI cards with an icon, large title, and subtle hover effects.
component_instructions.why_choose_us: 5 icon points. Layout in an asymmetrical grid or staggered list.
component_instructions.gallery_section: Masonry grid with categories + fullscreen lightbox. (Use 'react-photo-album' + 'yet-another-react-lightbox').
component_instructions.process_section: 4 Steps. Numbered manifesto chapters with vertical connecting lines.
component_instructions.reviews_section: Card carousel or slow marquee. Dark surfaces.
component_instructions.contact_form: Shadcn Form. Fields: Name, Phone, Email, Service Dropdown, Location, Date, Description, File Upload, GDPR Checkbox.
component_instructions.mobile_sticky_cta: Fixed bottom bar on mobile viewports only, with quick action to call or get a quote.
component_instructions.footer: Company info, IČO 17693021, big 'LET'S TALK' text at 10vw, GDPR links. Footer background must contrast slightly with the section above it.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur), but never fully transparent backgrounds over dynamic content.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Ensure contrast ratios are met (4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text).
Explicit hover and focus states for all interactive elements (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white). Focus states must have HIGHER contrast.
Use a single, distinctive art direction throughout.
Limit the use of the primary brand color (gold) to actionable CTAs and key highlights to maintain its power.
data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Use kebab-case, role-based naming conventions (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='contact-form-submit').
